summary: Prompt search input correctly debounces (250ms) and performs case-insensitive substring filtering (searching 'helix' and 'HELIX' both isolated the Shell Helix prompt from 10 to 1 row). Malicious XSS vector '">' was properly neutralized with 0 injected scripts/img tags, window.__xss_vulnerable remained false/undefined, and rendered the localized empty state message 'Geçerli filtrelere uyan prompt yok.'. Clearing the search input cleanly restored all 10 rows.
